en: Sepia-toned historic waterfront scene showing fishing boats docked at a quay in front of a busy market square. People walk along the steps and stalls at the fish market, with horse-drawn carts and awnings visible. Prominent brick buildings stand behind the market, one signed for a clothing and tailoring business, with a large terraced residential block on the hill in the background. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the view as Göteborg, Fisktorget & Kungshöjd, and the publisher name Jolin & Wilkenson, Göteborg appears in the lower right.
